12.text: Subhanallahi wal-hamdülillahi wa la ilaha illallahu vallahu akbar
12.translation: Glory be to Allah, praise be to Him, there is no god but Allah, and Allah is the greatest.

15.text: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa ala kulli shay'in qadir
15.translation: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah, alone, without partner. His is the dominion, His is the praise, and He has power over all things.

6.text: Subhanallahi wa bihamdihi adada khalqihi wa rida nafsihi wa zinata arshihi wa midada kalimatih
6.translation: Glory as well as praise be to Allah, equal to the number of His creatures, His pleasure, the weight of His Throne, and the ink of His words.

1.text: La ilaha illa anta subhanaka inni kuntu minaz-zalimin
1.translation: There is no god but You. Glory be to You! I have certainly been among the wrongdoers.

4.text: Hasbunallahu wa ni'mal-wakil, ni'mal-mawla wa ni'man-nasir
4.translation: Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best Disposer of affairs. What a wonderful protector and what a wonderful helper.

2.text: Hasbiyallahu la ilaha illa hu, alayhi tawakkaltu wa huwa rabbul-arshil-azim
2.translation: Allah is sufficient for me. There is no god but Him. I put my trust in Him, and He is the Lord of the Great Throne.

8.text: Ya Hayyu Ya Qayyum birahmatika astagithu, aslih li sha'ni kullahu wa la takilni ila nafsi tarfata ayn
8.translation: O Ever-Living, O Sustainer, by Your mercy I seek help. Rectify all my affairs and do not leave me to myself for even the blink of an eye.

7.text: Astaghfirullahal-azim alladhi la ilaha illa huwal-hayyul-qayyumu wa atubu ilayh
7.translation: I seek forgiveness from Allah the Magnificent, besides whom there is no god, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer, and I repent to Him.

3.text: Rabbi inni massaniyad-durru wa anta arhamur-rahimin
3.translation: My Lord! Indeed, distress has touched me, and You are the Most Merciful of the merciful.

10.text: Allahumme salli ala sayyidina Muhammadin salatan tunjina biha min jami'il-ahwali wal-afat
10.translation: O Allah! Bless our master Muhammad with a prayer through which You save us from all terrors and calamities.

11.text: Allahumme salli salatan kamilatan wa sallim salaman tamman ala sayyidina Muhammadinil-ladhi tanhallo bihil-uqad
11.translation: O Allah! Bestow a perfect blessing and a complete peace upon our master Muhammad, through whom knots are untied.

5.text: Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanatan wa fil-akhirati hasanatan wa qina adhaban-nar
5.translation: Our Lord! Give us in this world that which is good and in the Hereafter that which is good and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

14.text: Rabbi hab li min ladunka dhurriyatan tayyibatan innaka sami'ud-du'a
14.translation: My Lord! Grant me from Yourself a good offspring. Indeed, You are the Hearer of supplication.

9.translation: There is no god but Allah, the King, the Truth, the Manifest.

13.translation: O Lord of Majesty and Honor!

notifications.daily_body: Hearts find rest only in the remembrance of Allah. How about a short dhikr break? 🌙
